title: Lab 4: Safe Isolated Surface EMG (IEC 60601 + FIR)
author: Bioelectrical Lab Sim Demo
description: Design a patient-safe single-supply AD620 surface EMG front end meeting IEC 60601 isolation goals (ADuM3160 USB isolator + secondary high-pass DC blocking), then apply an FIR digital filter on Arduino Nano.

steps.title: Mount 3-Pad EMG & Insert ADuM3160 USB Isolator
steps.instruction: Place an Arduino Nano on the breadboard (non-ELVIS isolated mode), confirm 3-Pad Surface EMG is mounted in the Sensors tab, and click Insert on the ADuM3160 USB Isolator.
steps.hint: Watch the inline teal ADuM3160 2.5kV ISO module attach to the Nano's USB port, separating the patient acquisition circuit from host PC USB mains ground.

checks.label: 3-Pad EMG mounted + ADuM3160 USB Isolator inserted (no ELVIS bridge)

steps.title: Wire Single-Supply AD620 Instrumentation Amplifier
steps.instruction: Place the AD620 straddling the center trough with a 100 Ω gain resistor across RG1–RG2 (G ≈ 495). Power +VS from +5 V and −VS from GND, create a +2.5 V virtual ground (two 10 kΩ resistors) for AD620 REF & EMG BLK, and connect EMG RED 1/2 to IN+/IN−.
steps.hint: Using a +2.5 V virtual ground (10 kΩ / 10 kΩ divider) keeps the single-supply AD620 comfortably inside its common-mode input range.

steps.title: Add Secondary High-Pass Isolation & Verify IEC 60601
steps.instruction: Place a 1 µF film capacitor in series between the AD620 OUT and Arduino Nano pin A0, biased to +2.5 V using two 10 kΩ resistors (fc ≈ 31.8 Hz). Verify the green IEC 60601 Isolated ✓ badge appears!
steps.hint: The series 1 µF capacitor blocks single-fault DC offset while passing AC skeletal muscle bursts (~20–250 Hz). Click Inspect on the safety pill to review every IEC 60601 check.

checks.label: Full IEC 60601 Safe Isolation achieved (fc ≤ 60 Hz)

steps.title: Filter the Isolated EMG Stream with #include <FIR.h>
steps.instruction: Open the Nano tab, load or write a sketch using #include <FIR.h> to read A0 and smooth the EMG bursts, click Upload & Run, and observe Raw vs Filtered EMG in the Serial Plotter.
steps.hint: Try the built-in 'FIR Filter: 3-Pad EMG Low-Pass' example sketch and adjust EMG Flex & 60 Hz Hum in the Bench Stimulus bar.
